I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I couldn't confirm her tip that Linnea Merriwether is the main contact for the Hollybank rollout at Marrow Agrisupply.

- **What I checked:** I searched the workspace brain (gbrain), which holds the channel history and public files Ilse can see. The only mention of Linnea Merriwether or a Hollybank rollout was Ilse's own message. The search was keyword-only, so it could miss items that use different wording. I didn't read any channels or files directly.
- **What I told her:** I'm keeping it marked as unverified hearsay and won't list Linnea as the contact until someone confirms it.
- **Who can confirm:** Marrow Agrisupply is a Central team account, so I suggested Hollis, Priyanka or Tobias.
